items.title: 68190_Samuel
items.q: Basie wired me to come to Newark, New Jersey, the Adams Theater, and I walk in there and the music was all stacked up on Jo Jones' tom tom, you know, and I just had to play the whole show down man without any rehearsal

ctx.x: Well, now you had to read when you were with Basie. Tell us about that, when you showed up with Basie, about the charts.

Oh, I had no rehearsal at all. We just had to walked in there and played. Jo Jones was drummer, you know, at the time and Basie wired me to come to Newark, New Jersey, the Adams Theater, and I walk in there and the music was all stacked up on Jo Jones' tom tom, you know, and I just had to play the whole show down man without any rehearsal or anything and now that's something very hard to do, I'll tell you that.
If you couldn't read, you couldn't play it so I had to read all the music and everything that was there.
